alt: This snake thought it found 3 eggs. They were golf balls. — @cursedbulletin
caption:
This snake thought it found 3 eggs. They were golf balls.

At an exotic animal hospital in San Antonio, Texas, vets sedated the snake and gently massaged all three golf balls back up through its body and out its mouth. No surgery needed.

Nobody knows why it ate them. Best guess: it mistook the white balls for eggs.

That's the bulletin.
Cursed or not? 👇

alt: He told the cops he wasn't a physical being. Then got arrested in his underwear. — @cursedbulletin
caption:
He told the cops he wasn't a physical being. Then got arrested in his underwear.

On Sep 24, Elijah Hemingway allegedly broke into a Pittsburgh-area doctor's home at 12:30 AM. Dr. Idris Evans, a 46-year-old pediatric critical care physician, was killed; his wife critically injured. The kids, 8 and 12, escaped to a neighbor's.

During the attack he ranted about being "God." And in 2025 bodycam footage, he told Florida cops he was King Tutankhamun — "a spirit, not a physical being"  while jumping over cars in a parking lot.

22 prior charges. Accused, not convicted.

alt: Imagine finding out your kid has 109 half-siblings. From a spreadsheet. — @cursedbulletin
caption:
Imagine finding out your kid has 109 half-siblings. From a spreadsheet.

Denmark's European Sperm Bank just got reported to the police after an investigation found 81 donors were used way beyond the legal limit  one man's sperm alone led to 110 children. Over 10,000 women and children are affected, and the bank is refusing to tell the families, blaming "privacy rules."

So thousands of parents now get to wonder how many siblings their kid has. Forever.

That's the bulletin.
Cursed or not?

alt: Cat in the Hat AI trend — cursed news bulletin
caption:
Somebody tell Dr. Seuss his cat needs a lawyer.

What started as AI memes of the Cat in the Hat has turned into real police cases. Students in Kansas, Georgia, Alabama and Kentucky were arrested after posting menacing edits naming actual schools as the cat's next targets.

In British Columbia, a teenage girl was chased by someone in a full Cat in the Hat costume. She made it home safe. Police are still looking for him.

A children's book character now has a criminal record. Dumbest timeline ever.

Cursed or not? 👇
